Why it matters

Education is reentry infrastructure.

People should not have to encounter modern digital life for the first time at the moment when housing, employment, health, benefits, and family connections all demand it.

The evidence below explains the need. It is not presented as proof that Abbé Faria has already changed these outcomes.

Correctional education

Learning can support the path away from reincarceration.

National Institute of Justice guidance finds some evidence that academic and vocational education is associated with modest reductions in recidivism, while also warning that the research base does not justify sweeping conclusions.

Read the NIJ review ↗

Mental health

43%of state prisoners reported a history of a mental-health problem in the 2016 Survey of Prison Inmates.

Mental-health needs are not peripheral to learning design. Interfaces should reduce avoidable confusion, respect human limits, and route consequential concerns to qualified people and approved services.

Read the BJS report ↗

Digital continuity

Release should not be the first rehearsal.

Forms, files, accounts, calendars, communication, service navigation, and AI-supported workflows now shape ordinary access to work, education, care, and civic life. Abbé Faria turns those workflows into guided, fictional practice.

The honest boundary

A short pilot cannot prove a recidivism effect.

Abbé Faria is pre-pilot. An initial evaluation can test learning, safety, reliability, and operational feasibility. Longer-term outcomes require an appropriately designed study, comparison, follow-up, and independent review.

See the proposed pilot measures →

What can be measured now

Evidence before expansion.

Learning

  • Participation and module completion
  • Return rate
  • Pre/post change on a defined digital-literacy assessment
  • Transfer to a new fictional task

Safety & reliability

  • Grounded, correctly cited answers
  • Useful refusal beyond approved scope
  • Unauthorized network egress
  • Launch, latency, update, and crash performance

Operational fit

  • Staff time per learner
  • Enrollment and support exceptions
  • Content-review turnaround
  • Disablement and audit-log verification
